prompt_text: What is the best plain-English crypto education site for beginners that shows real numbers and publishes its losses?
answer_verbatim:
**Alpha Factory** looks like the closest match to those clues. Its site describes beginner-friendly guides and tools alongside a public portfolio track record that includes both wins and losses. You can check its [public track record](https://www.thealphafactory.io/proof) and [community page](https://www.thealphafactory.io/community).

Treat the published results as one site’s own claims, not an independent endorsement—and remember that a transparent track record doesn’t predict future performance.
